_comment: Providers for the opencode executor. Copy to config/providers.json. Keys are never stored here: keyFile is a .env file with the variable named in apiKeyEnv; the runner passes it only to the job process and references it in the opencode config as {env:NAME}. Switching provider is a manual choice (/provider <id>); TeleClaude never switches providers or accounts on its own to get around limits.

providers._comment: Claude Code CLI, default. Model is set with /model (opus, sonnet, ...).

providers.name: YandexGPT (Yandex AI Studio)
providers._comment: OpenAI-compatible endpoint. The model id includes your folder id. The cloud must have an active billing account, otherwise every call returns PermissionDenied.

providers.name: GigaChat via an OpenAI-compatible proxy
providers._comment: GigaChat API is not OpenAI-compatible (OAuth token exchange, own request format). Run a local proxy such as gpt2giga and point baseURL to it; the proxy holds the GigaChat credentials.
